description: Turn a PDF, Word file, slide deck or scanned page into clean Markdown, with tables and layout kept and OCR on scanned pages. Priced by the page limit you choose. Price: from $0.007 per document, charged only on success. Price depends on max_pages: 1 $0.007, 5 $0.028, 20 $0.109, 50 $0.271 (default 5). One call = the Markdown text of one document.

file.description: Public URL of a .pdf, .doc, .docx, .ppt, .pptx or image file (https)

force_ocr.description: Read every page as an image (for scans with a bad text layer), default false

max_pages.description: Most pages to read; sets the price. Default 5

name: document-to-markdown
title: Document to Markdown (PDF, Word, slides)
